# Thank you, mod authors!

To everyone who creates and shares game fixes: thank you. Your time, curiosity,
and generosity help more people enjoy their games on the screens they love.
This project is possible because of your work.

Special thanks to:

- [Lyall](https://codeberg.org/Lyall), for an extraordinary collection of game fixes.
  If you enjoy his work, consider supporting him on
  [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/Wintermance) or [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/W7W01UAI9).
- [MinuteReversal](https://github.com/MinuteReversal/MHW16x10Fix), for MHW16x10Fix.
- [Nicolas Busseneau](https://github.com/nbusseneau/hephaistos), for Hephaistos, the Hades aspect-ratio patcher.
- [TEODORMAX](https://www.nexusmods.com/finalfantasyxiii2/mods/42), for Final Fantasy XIII-2 and Lightning Returns fixes.
- [Twig](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2953302517), for the Undertale Ultrawide Fix.
- [TechieW](https://github.com/techiew/EldenRingMods), for EldenRingMods and the [Elden Ring Ultrawide Fix](https://www.nexusmods.com/eldenring/mods/7870).
- [Refilo](https://www.nexusmods.com/finalfantasyresonance/mods/29), for the Final Fantasy Resonance Ultrawide Mod.
- [p1xel8ted](https://github.com/p1xel8ted/UltrawideFixes), for the Hollow Knight and Hollow Knight: Silksong Ultra-Wide mods.
- [Kamiccolo](https://community.pcgamingwiki.com/files/file/2432-final-fantasy-xx-2-hd-remaster-anima-edition/), for the Final Fantasy X/X-2 HD Remaster patches.
  If you enjoy their work, consider supporting them on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/kamiccolo).
- [PhantomGamers](https://github.com/PhantomGamers/SUWSF), for SUWSF.
- [Yuki](https://yuki.pet/daemon-x-machina-titanic-scion-widescreen-fix/), for the Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion Widescreen Fix.
- [m.vico](https://www.nexusmods.com/kingdomheartsfinalmix/mods/230), for Keyblade Masters Ultrawide for Kingdom Hearts I.5+II.5 ReMIX and Kingdom Hearts III.
- [rebtd7](https://github.com/rebtd7/FF13Fix), for FF13Fix, and Nucleoprotein for OneTweakNG.
- [ellekz](https://www.nexusmods.com/darksouls3/mods/2046), for the Dark Souls III fullscreen fix.
  If you enjoy their work, consider supporting them on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/loreciao).
- [Nozomi Miyamori](https://github.com/nm004/ngs2-nm-plugin), for the Ninja Gaiden Sigma 2 NM Plugin.
- [Fiend Busa](https://www.nexusmods.com/ninjagaidenmastercollection/mods/37), for the Ninja Gaiden Sigma 2 Black Mod.

Thank you as well to every contributor and author credited in the individual
mod READMEs and licenses. Please visit the original projects for their work,
documentation, and support. The [game list](../README.md#game-mods) links to
each mod and its author.
